acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and unusually so. Tally's free tier ships unlimited forms, unlimited submissions, payments, e-signatures, conditional logic, calculations, and integrations with Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, Zapier, and Make. The main paywalled items are removing branding, custom domains, drop-off analytics, and unlimited file uploads (the free plan caps individual files at 10 MB). Those live on Pro at $24/mo.

mainEntity.name: How does Tally compare to Typeform on features?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tally gives you more raw functionality on free (payments, signatures, unlimited responses, integrations). Typeform gives you a more polished conversational format, one-question-per-page UX, and Typeform AI on paid tiers. Typeform's brand feel is stronger; Tally's price-to-features ratio is better. For most transactional forms, Tally covers the ground. For customer-facing surveys and quizzes where feel matters, Typeform tends to win.

mainEntity.name: Which one is cheaper, Tally or Typeform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tally, by a wide margin. Tally Pro is $24/mo (around $20/mo yearly) and unlocks the full paid feature set. Typeform's comparable tier is Business at $91/mo yearly with a 10,000 response cap. Typeform Basic starts at $28/mo yearly but only allows 100 responses per month. Even Typeform's Plus at $56/mo yearly caps at 1,000 responses. Tally is materially cheaper for any real workload.

No. As of 2026-07-26 Tally does not offer HIPAA compliance on any tier, including Business at $74/mo. Teams collecting patient data need to look at Typeform Enterprise (custom contract) or another HIPAA-eligible form builder. Formester is also not HIPAA-certified today.

mainEntity.name: Is Typeform better than Tally for surveys?

acceptedAnswer.text: For customer-facing surveys where completion rate is the KPI, Typeform's one-question-per-page format tends to produce higher completion than Tally's scroll layout. For internal surveys, structured feedback, or anything long-form, Tally reads faster because respondents see the shape of the form up front. Match the format to the audience and the length.

mainEntity.name: Can I collect payments on Tally's free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Payments are one of the features Tally ships on the free tier, alongside e-signatures, conditional logic, and unlimited submissions. Stripe is the primary integration. Typeform, in contrast, gates payment collection to paid tiers.

mainEntity.name: Which has better templates, Tally or Typeform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typeform has the larger and more visually polished library at 800+ templates, organized by use case. Tally publishes a smaller curated gallery without a marketed template count. If a template-first workflow matters to you, Typeform wins. If you plan to build most forms from scratch or with AI, the gap does not matter.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for lead capture, Tally or Typeform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depends on the intent. High-intent, form-in-a-page style capture (contact us, demo requests, waitlists) works fine on either, and Tally is cheaper. Marketing-funnel lead capture where you want conversational qualification, video embeds, and polished outcome pages leans Typeform, though at higher cost. For B2B teams routing leads into CRM, both integrate with Zapier and native webhooks.

mainEntity.name: Does Tally have AI form generation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. As of 2026-07-26 Tally has not shipped an AI form generator. Typeform ships Typeform AI on Basic and above. Formester ships an AI generator on the free tier that accepts a prompt, a question list, or a PDF as input.

mainEntity.name: Where does Formester fit in this comparison?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester sits between Tally and Typeform on price and above both on AI. The free plan matches Tally's generosity (unlimited forms, unlimited responses, payments) and adds an AI generator that accepts a prompt, a question list, or a PDF as input. The Personal tier is $12/mo yearly, and Business is $45/mo yearly with offline forms and native Stripe plus PayPal. Formester is not HIPAA-certified.

mainEntity.name: How do I migrate from Typeform to Tally or Formester?

acceptedAnswer.text: Export your existing typeforms and responses as CSV from within Typeform. Rebuild the form in the destination product (Tally uses a Notion-style block editor; Formester's AI generator can take a question list or PDF and produce the form for you). Set up a 301 redirect from the old Typeform URL to preserve inbound links. A single-form migration typically takes 20 to 45 minutes end to end.

mainEntity.name: What are the best alternatives to Tally and Typeform in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: The short list most teams shortlist alongside Tally and Typeform: Formester (AI-first, unlimited free plan, offline forms), Jotform (largest template library, HIPAA on Silver+), Google Forms (free, Google Workspace-native, limited features), and Microsoft Forms (Microsoft 365-native). Pick based on where your source of truth already lives and which features are non-negotiable.

The honest read

Why teams leave Tally and Typeform

Sourced from G2, Capterra, Reddit reviews and the live pricing pages, not made up.

Why teams leave Tally

  • No AI form generator as of July 2026. Teams that draft with a prompt or a PDF outgrow Tally the day they try to move faster.
  • No offline mobile app. Field teams collecting responses without connectivity hit a wall.
  • No HIPAA on any tier. Healthcare buyers cannot legally use Tally for patient data.
  • Drop-off analytics gated behind Pro $24/mo. Free users cannot see where forms leak.
  • 10 MB file cap on free. Passport photos or contract PDFs bounce before submission.
  • No dashboards beyond visit analytics. Reporting is thin the moment you outgrow Google Sheets.

Why teams leave Typeform

  • Free plan hard cap at 10 responses per month. Any live form outgrows it in a week.
  • Remove branding gated to Plus at $56/mo. Basic keeps the Typeform logo on every page.
  • HIPAA is Enterprise-only. Regulated teams have to pay for a custom contract to stay compliant.
  • Ask AI sits on Growth Flow at $266/mo. The jump from Business is the biggest step in the pricing page.
  • Per-user pricing on Business (5 users). Adding a sixth teammate pushes teams to Enterprise sales.
  • One-question-per-page slows long forms. Great for surveys, painful for a 40-field intake.

Logic, integrations, and offline: Formester vs Typeform

Conditional logic that actually branches

Field-level show / hide / require / route rules across multiple inputs, not just section-level branching. Show a question only if a Likert score is below 3, route the response to a CS lead, fire a webhook on submit. The full engine unlocks on Personal at $12 per month, billed annually.

Integrations and AI agent surface

Native HubSpot, Google Sheets, Slack, Stripe, PayPal, Calendly, n8n, Pabbly, OttoKit, GA4, and GTM. Webhooks fire on submission created / updated / deleted on every plan. REST API v2 on Business plus an MCP server that plugs into Claude or ChatGPT. The Typeform alternative for teams running AI agents on form data.

Typeform ~50 integrations, deep Airtable / Notion / Sheets sync, no MCP

Offline forms that ship as installable apps

Formester forms install as a PWA on phones, tablets, and laptops. Field teams collect responses with no connection, submissions queue on the device, and sync the moment the network returns. Available on the free plan, no app store install. Typeform has no native offline option, which is a real gap for in-store, event, and field-research collection.

Migration

How to switch from Typeform to Formester in 3 steps

From "I want to leave Typeform" to "the new form is live" without losing data or missing submissions.

1

Export your existing entries

In Typeform, open Forms → Submissions → Export CSV. Capture each form's responses as a CSV. Pull integration logs (Airtable / Notion sync history) for reference.

Time: 5 to 10 minutes for a typical 5-form workspace.

2

Rebuild with the AI form generator

Sign up for Formester (free, no card). Open the AI form generator, paste a description of the Typeform form, or upload the questions list. The generator drafts the structure with field types, validation, and conditional logic. Edit the labels and apply your branding.

Time: 10 to 20 minutes per form for a typical 10-field form.

3

Re-point your integrations

Update the destination on your Airtable / Notion / Slack / Zapier flows from Typeform's webhook endpoints to Formester's. Test one submission, confirm the integration fires, then archive the Typeform form.

Time: 10 to 15 minutes; keep Typeform active for a week as a fallback.

Honest comparison

When Tally or Typeform is still the better choice

Two real cases each. Where Tally beats Formester, and where Typeform beats both of us. We are the alternative for the rest.

When Tally is the better choice

  • You are a solo shipper or a Notion-native team and you want a truly free builder that never asks for a card. Tally ships unlimited forms, unlimited submissions, native payments, e-signatures, and conditional logic on $0.
  • You need EU-first GDPR hosting. Tally is Belgium-based and stores data in Europe by default, which shortens the security review for EU buyers.
  • You want the Notion-style block editor aesthetic without touching a designer. Tally's builder feels like a Notion doc, which is a plus for teams that already live in that surface.
  • Honest tradeoff: Formester gives you the AI form generator, offline forms, and PDF exports Tally does not ship. Pick Tally if none of those matter to you.

When Typeform is the better choice

  • Your survey has to feel like a conversation. Typeform pioneered the one-question-per-page format, keyboard-first navigation, and animated transitions. If completion rate depends on how the form feels, Typeform is the benchmark.
  • You need HIPAA today. Typeform ships HIPAA on Enterprise. Formester is not HIPAA-certified, and Tally does not offer HIPAA on any tier.
  • You are hiring at scale and want a dedicated HR plan. Typeform Talent starts around $119/mo and is built for recruiting workflows. Neither Tally nor Formester ships an HR-specific tier.
  • Honest tradeoff: Business is $91/mo per 5 users on Typeform. If brand perception justifies the price and you do not need offline forms, Typeform is the fit.

Privacy and data ownership

Your form data is yours. We don't train on it

The prompts you write, the AI-generated form structures, and the responses respondents submit are all Customer Data. Per Section 4.4 of our Data Processing Addendum, Formester does not use Customer Data to train AI models, run advertising, run analytics, or feed marketing. The Google Gemini integration that drafts forms inherits the same boundary.

Your account is encrypted at rest, responses move over TLS, and payment data carries an additional AES-256 layer through Stripe. We are GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. We are not SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA certified yet, and we say so on the security page rather than implying otherwise. If your buying review requires those today, we'll tell you up front.

FAQs

Frequently asked questions

Everything else people ask when picking between Formester, Tally, and Typeform.

Is Tally really free?
Yes. Tally's free plan gives unlimited forms, unlimited submissions, native payments, e-signatures, conditional logic, and Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, and Zapier integrations at $0. The paid Pro tier at $24/mo mostly unlocks branding removal, custom domains, unlimited file uploads, and drop-off analytics.
How does Tally compare to Typeform on features?
Tally is broader on the free tier (unlimited responses, payments, e-signatures included). Typeform is polished on completion rate thanks to the one-question-per-page conversational format, quizzes, and Typeform AI. Tally has no AI form generator. Typeform caps free at 10 responses/mo.
Which one is cheaper, Tally or Typeform?
Tally is cheaper for teams that live on the free tier. Once you need branding removal or custom domains, Tally Pro is $24/mo (about $20/mo billed yearly). Typeform's cheapest paid tier is Basic at $28/mo yearly, but branding removal only opens on Plus at $56/mo. So Tally is meaningfully cheaper for the same real-world need.
Does Tally have HIPAA compliance?
No. Tally does not offer HIPAA on any tier. Typeform ships HIPAA on Enterprise. Formester is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant but is not HIPAA-certified either. For patient data today, Typeform Enterprise is the only fit of the three.
Is Typeform better than Tally for surveys?
Typeform is designed for surveys and quizzes where completion rate depends on feel. The one-question-per-page format, keyboard navigation, and animated transitions are still the reference implementation. Tally works fine for short surveys but does not match Typeform's polish on longer conversational flows.
Can I collect payments on Tally's free plan?
Yes. Native payments ship on Tally's free tier with no volume cap. Typeform ties payments to Stripe on paid plans only, so the free tier cannot accept money. Formester also allows payment collection on the free plan.
Which has better templates, Tally or Typeform?
Typeform ships around 800 templates, tuned for conversational surveys. Tally has a smaller starter library skewed toward SaaS and creator use cases. If template breadth is a hard requirement, Typeform wins. If you build from scratch anyway, the gap disappears.
Which is better for lead capture, Tally or Typeform?
For lead capture volume, Tally wins on cost (unlimited submissions on free). For lead capture quality on branded landing pages, Typeform wins on conversion polish once you can afford Plus at $56/mo. Formester sits between: unlimited responses on free plus drop-off analytics included.
Does Tally have AI form generation?
No, not as of July 2026. Typeform ships Typeform AI on Basic and above (prompt-based only). Formester ships an AI form generator on the free plan that accepts a prompt, a question list, or a PDF.
Where does Formester fit in this comparison?
Formester is the middle option: modern editor without Typeform's price jumps, AI form generator Tally does not have, offline forms Tally does not ship, unlimited responses on free, and native Stripe plus PayPal payments. Not the pick if you need HIPAA today or Typeform-grade conversational polish.
How do I migrate from Typeform to Tally or Formester?
Export existing forms and responses as CSV from Typeform (paid plans allow this). Rebuild the form in Tally by dragging blocks, or in Formester by pasting the question list into the AI generator to auto-build it. Redirect the old Typeform URL with a 301 to preserve inbound links. A single-form migration usually takes under 30 minutes.
What are the best alternatives to Tally and Typeform in 2026?
The most-shortlisted alternatives are Formester (unlimited free plus AI generator plus offline), Jotform (largest template library, HIPAA on Gold), Google Forms (free inside Google Workspace), forms.app (EU hosting with AI), and Wufoo (SurveyMonkey-owned, mature). Which one wins depends on whether you need HIPAA, offline collection, an AI generator, or a specific integration.
